term: strict efficacy of a rigid act token
definition: For one Lean value a as the act and one being x as the effect: at every world accessible from w where a is performed, x exists. This is the box of a material conditional; it says nothing about production, and it is weaker than #462's StableActOutput with realization, which yields it.
note: See docs/notes/simplicity-collapse-555.md. Stipulative analyst notion for #555; no source is claimed for it.
